Lantern Angel (CV 16)

A small winged guardian carries a light within its chest, brightening whenever it finds someone who is lost.

Attributes: Brawn +0; Fortitude +1; Agility +1; Guile +1; Knowledge +2; Reason +2

HP: 14 · Speed: 5; fly 7 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 0*

Evasion: 1 Bane · Threat: None · Stability: 0

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Radiant (2)\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates a complete outcome. All attacks use printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Guiding ray

Target: One visible creature within 6 squares. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: radiant.

Weak defense: Blinded 2. Standard defense: Blinded 1.

Warding Light

A warm light settles over one companion like a hand on the shoulder.

One willing ally within 3 squares reduces Frightened by 1. Until this creature’s next turn, that ally also has 1 Boon on its next defense against a mental attack; for an NPC ally, impose 1 Bane on that player attack. Consumed even if canceled; does not stack with itself.

Sheltering Light

Light gathers over a companion like overlapping feathers, taking the harsh edge from the impact.

Before one visible willing ally within 3 squares takes damage from an attack, grant that ally Physical resistance 2 for that attack only. Use the highest matching resistance, not an added reduction; minimum damage rules remain. This does not heal, transfer damage or grant resistance to other types.

Guide the Light

A ribbon of lanternlight runs along the path, picking out each stone on the way to shelter.

Brightly light up to 3 connected squares within 3 squares until the start of this creature's next turn. Requires an unobstructed path from this creature to each square; it may choose unlit squares. Ordinary darkness imposes no Boons or Banes for seeing those squares; cover, concealment and hiding still use the normal rules. This neither reveals Hidden creatures automatically nor penetrates opaque obstacles. Reusing this ability replaces its previous illuminated area.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Tactics and retreat: Flash at a pursuer and steady the frightened traveler it was sent to find. It favors escape over punishment.

Encounter and conversation: Its instructions prioritize one missing traveler while a larger rescue unfolds nearby.

Habitat: Sacred boundary; refuge; contested oath · Communication: Common

Loot: Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play
